title: Palindrome Signal
story:
Distress beacons repeat a call sign that reads the same forwards and backwards. Check incoming signals, **ignoring upper and lower case**.

Input: one word, letters only, 1–100 characters.

Output: `YES` if it's a palindrome ignoring case, otherwise `NO`.

Example: `Level` prints `YES`; `Kernel` prints `NO`.
hints: Compare the first and last letters, then the second and second-to-last, moving inwards.
`'L'` and `'l'` are different chars. `tolower(c)` from `<ctype.h>` turns a letter lowercase.
Two indexes: `i = 0`, `j = len - 1`. While `i < j`, if `tolower(word[i]) != tolower(word[j])` it's NO; otherwise move both inwards.
